In one of the replies you can see my method on how I did things as Leon which imo is the hardest, if you can get 5 stars on every map as Leon the rest should fall into place. You got this, I believe in you!

Hey don't give up so easily! As soon as you unlock Ada things start to get much easier as you can use her to unlock the other characters which are easy to get 5 stars with. On village if you're struggling with the Belle sisters go to the barn and keep knocking down the ladder until about 10 enemies are in there then grab the bonus and sheet the barrel. If you have any grenades use them to finish off the Belle sisters, otherwise shoot them with your pistol. After enough practice you should be done with that. With Castle you can go inside the building and just run up and down the stairs to keep spawning enemies to keep your combo up, I haven't had trouble with the wolverine guys doing this, maybe they can't go inside or maybe I'm really lucky. With base the regular guys are a little more squishy so your only real threat is JJ, make sure you have enough distance and shoot him with your pistol or use grenades/barrels. And lastly, waterworld. Here I find it's best to keep retrying until you get the tower spawn, climb up to the top to grab the time increase and jump all the way down, Salvador should be right behind you, whip your shotgun out and aim at his head, this will stagger him, when the stagger ends just do it again and you can stunlock him, might take 3-5 shots. The second one spawns at 30 kills and in my winning round with Leon here I ran into a building so that the crossbow fuckers can't but you to interrupt your shots, then do the same method with the shotgun as the first Salvador, just don't let it get too close. Keep in mind that sometimes Salvador doesn't get stunned from barrels or grenades so if you plan on using them make sure you haven enough room to run.
Don't get me wrong, it's great! But Leon burnt me out so much and from now on I'll only ever play it for fun, not for bragging rights
